project.project_title: I want to publish my paperback book. I am looking for an editor who can help me polish my manuscript

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Thank you for replying, Nadia.

I am raising two young children, and the book draws on both my own experiences and those borrowed from others. It guides new parents on setting boundaries without uncomfortable conversations and explains how visitors should behave around a newborn and the parents. In particular, it addresses the questions exhausted new Indian parents face: when people may visit, how long they should stay, and why they should not kiss the baby. I have also included checklists, Do's & Don'ts tables, and anecdotes.

Because I am preparing my debut book, I would appreciate your help refining it into something readers will enjoy and publishing it successfully as a paperback.

Could you advise me on the following?
1\. What process should we follow?
2\. What would the price and timeline be?

value_updates.editorial_goal: Refine the manuscript into something readers will enjoy.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: Although I have finished editing the work, the contract appears to be on hold.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports that manuscript editing has been completed.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hello Nadia. I accepted almost all of the track changes and added a few more details. For the sections I added, however, I cannot tell whether the track changes are displaying properly; perhaps they are, but I am unsure. To make the additions unmistakable, I highlighted them in YELLOW.

Could you clarify these two points?
1\. Is this sentence correctly structured: So, I used to eat before anyone or sometimes after everytime, basically it was on demand.?
2\. In the passage about what I needed from my partner, the references to answering the door, checking whether my water bottle was filled and nearby, giving me a hug, checking in on me, putting a blanket on me, and managing visitors read as though I merely wished those things had happened. The small things meant everything, but I need the passage to convey that I actually experienced them. How should it be restructured? For example, he did check on me, fill my bottle, and keep it within a hand's reach.

value_updates.sentence_clarity: Restructure the cited meal sentence into grammatically natural prose while preserving its intended meaning.
value_updates.meaning_preservation: The partner passage must state that the supportive actions actually occurred rather than suggesting they were only wished for.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Also, let's go with the 2 edits you mentioned:
1\. So, I ate whenever I was hungry. Sometimes I ate before everyone else, and sometimes afterwards. My meals were completely on demand.
2\. The thing I needed most from my partner was not grand gestures. He answered the door when visitors arrived. He made sure my water bottle was always filled and within my reach. Sometimes he would simply check in on me, give me a hug, or put a blanket over me. He managed the visitors so I didn't have to. They were small acts, but they meant everything.
